heading_en: Special Exclusion from Calculation of the BI
summary_ja: 処分した連結子法人等又は事業部門を、承認を得てBIの算出から除外できる特例を定める。
summary_en: Allows, with approval, exclusion from the BI calculation of disposed-of consolidated subsidiaries or business units.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company may, where it has obtained the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency, exclude from the calculation of the BI consolidated subsidiary corporations, etc. or business units that it has disposed of.
